extDescription.message: Suggests a truly random password whenever a site asks for a new one, fills it and submits with Touch ID. Nothing is stored, nothing leaves your Mac.

popupNoField.message: No password field on this page.

popupLastHelp.message: Kept in session memory only, until Brave offers to save it. It is gone when the browser closes.

confirmFillSubmit.message: Fill a strong password on $1 and submit the form.

confirmEnroll.message: First use: Touch ID will create the MDP Gen key on this Mac.

confirmUnsupported.message: Touch ID is not available here.

confirmDone.message: Filled. Brave will offer to save this password.

confirmFillFailed.message: The field could not be filled. Reload the page and try again.

optionsIntro.message: Everything is set here. No password is ever written to disk, no data leaves your machine.

optSymbolSetHelp.message: ASCII punctuation only. The default set avoids quotes, apostrophe, slash and pipe, which sites often reject.

optRequireEach.message: At least one character from each active set

optRequireEachHelp.message: Guarantees an uppercase, a lowercase, a digit and a symbol. The draw stays uniform over the passwords that satisfy the rule.

optExcludeAmbiguous.message: Avoid ambiguous characters (0 O 1 l I |)

optExcludeAmbiguousHelp.message: Useful when you have to type the password by hand.

optMaxConsecutive.message: Longest run of identical characters (0 = no limit)

optMaxConsecutiveHelp.message: Some sites reject “aaa”. The displayed entropy accounts for this rule.

optAutoSuggestHelp.message: Like Safari: as soon as the field gets focus, a strong password is filled and a bubble lets you keep it, draw another or decline. Type anything and the suggestion goes away.

optShowOnAllHelp.message: By default the bubble only appears on sign-up and change-password forms.

optSubmitAfterFill.message: Submit the form after Touch ID

optSubmitAfterFillHelp.message: The form is only submitted when complete and valid; otherwise the missing field is highlighted.

optRetain.message: Keep the last suggested password (minutes, 0 = never)

optRetainHelp.message: Session memory only, never on disk: a safety net if Brave did not offer to save. Visible from the popup, behind Touch ID.

optTouchIdHelp.message: Uses the platform authenticator (WebAuthn). The key stays in Brave, on this Mac. When disabled, the button fills and submits on a plain click.

touchIdStatusUnsupported.message: WebAuthn is not available in this browser.

touchIdStatusNotEnrolled.message: Touch ID is not enabled for MDP Gen yet.

touchIdResetDone.message: Key removed. It will be created again on next use.

aboutPrivacy.message: MDP Gen stores no password, sends nothing over the network and has no telemetry. Only these settings are saved.

aboutRandom.message: Randomness source: the browser's cryptographic generator (crypto.getRandomValues), fed on Mac by Apple's hardware generator. Each character is drawn by rejection, with no modulo bias.
